faq.metaDescription: Straight answers about privacy, earnings, content, contracts and how a partnership with KARAY Models actually works.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Straight answers to the questions a prospective model usually asks before joining our agency.
faq.highlightTitle: Yes, you can block Brazil or any other country on OnlyFans.
faq.highlightBody: It's the question we're asked most often, so it's the first one we answer.
faq.ctaHeadline: Talk to our team before you decide.
faq.ctaBody: We want you to fully understand how the partnership works before you commit to anything.

questions.question: Can I block Brazil on OnlyFans?
answer: Yes. This is the question we get most often from Brazilian applicants.
OnlyFans has geo-blocking features. We can block Brazil, or any other countries you choose, to reduce the chance of people in those places finding or reaching your page.
No feature offers absolute anonymity online, but geo-blocking is an important step toward greater privacy.

questions.question: Could my family or friends find out?
answer: No serious agency can guarantee that will never happen. What we can do is use strategies that reduce the risk considerably.

Those measures can include geo-blocking, professional accounts kept separate from personal ones, a dedicated residential proxy, a dedicated browser profile, targeted marketing and guidance on digital privacy.

questions.question: Do I have to show my face?
answer: Not necessarily.
Some models show their face; others use strategic framing, masks, lighting, editing or content with no facial identification at all.
The strategy is built around your goals, your boundaries and your comfort level.

questions.question: How much can I earn?
answer: There is no guaranteed income. Anyone promising guaranteed earnings is not being honest with you.
Results depend on how often you post and the quality of it, consistency, niche, positioning, marketing, subscriber interaction and how readily strategies are adapted.
Our goal is to build consistent, sustainable income without selling unrealistic expectations.

questions.question: How are earnings split?
answer: After platform fees, the standard split is 60% to the model, 20% to agency management and 20% to the marketing company.
For the first three months we usually waive our 20% management fee, so the model keeps a larger share while the account is still being built.
Every term is presented clearly before the partnership begins and written into the contract.

questions.question: Can I be paid in reais or in dollars?
answer: Yes. Depending on the method agreed, your payouts can be made in reais or in dollars.
Before the partnership starts we put in writing the currency, the payment schedule, the applicable conversion rates and the method used.

questions.question: Can the money be deposited straight into my account?
answer: Yes, that arrangement can be made available.
When platform payments go directly to the model's account, she becomes responsible for transferring the agency's and the marketing company's contracted percentages within the agreed deadlines.
This arrangement requires responsibility, financial organization and punctuality. Missing a payment is a breach of contract.

questions.question: Why is there an extra charge in the seventh month when I'm paid directly?
answer: When a model chooses to be paid directly, the agency takes on the risk of investing in infrastructure, technology, marketing and daily work without direct control over the percentages owed to it.
After six full months of partnership, a one-time additional amount equal to 20% of that month's net earnings is charged in the seventh month, as set out in the contract.
This should be understood as a deposit or security reserve that protects the continuity of the partnership and reduces the risk of future non-payment.
It is charged only once. The calculation, the due date and all conditions are explained before the contract is signed.

questions.question: Could being paid directly affect my Bolsa Família benefit?
answer: Yes, it can.

Some applicants and models belong to households that receive Bolsa Família. Once significant amounts start arriving directly in the model's bank account, those earnings may be counted in the assessment of household income.
Depending on the amount received, the household's per-person income and the rules in force, the benefit may be reduced, placed under a protection rule, suspended or ended.
We include this warning so that every model makes an informed decision before choosing to be paid directly.
The model should keep her Cadastro Único up to date and consult CRAS or a qualified professional about her specific situation.
The agency will never advise a model to hide income, withhold information or give incorrect data to the government.

questions.question: Who is responsible for taxes?
answer: Each model is responsible for her own filings, tax obligations and any taxes due in her country of residence.
The agency is not a substitute for an accountant, a lawyer or a tax adviser. Where needed, we recommend consulting a qualified professional.

questions.question: Do I have to produce content every day?
answer: You are not required to produce new content every day.
That said, your income tends to track directly with how often you send content, how much of it, and how good it is.
The more quality material we have on hand, the better we can keep your page active, plan posts, run campaigns, produce varied PPVs, test formats and keep subscribers interested.
A model who rarely sends content directly limits what the agency can do — and with it, her own earning potential.
We'll build a realistic production plan around your routine, but consistency will always matter.

questions.question: How do I send my photos and videos to the agency?
answer: Content is sent through a private Google Drive folder or a shared Google Photos album.
We don't recommend sending your main files over WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or similar apps, since those platforms compress photos and videos and degrade the quality.
When using Google Photos, select the original-quality option so the files keep their full resolution.
Our team organizes the folders by date, content type, campaign or category to make planning and publishing easier.

questions.question: Do I need professional equipment?
answer: Not necessarily.
A modern phone, good lighting, a tidy space and attention to framing can produce excellent content.
Our team provides guidance on lighting, settings, posing, formats and how to organize your files.

questions.question: Do I need experience?
answer: No.
We work with beginners as well as models who already have experience. Our team guides every stage of creating, positioning and developing your brand.

questions.question: Does the agency create all the accounts?
answer: Yes. Depending on the strategy, our team can create and configure OnlyFans, X, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, a professional email address, a links page and any other promotional accounts needed.
All of them are set up to our security and operating standards before the brand officially launches.

questions.question: Can I keep using an account I already have?
answer: Yes.
We can also manage an OnlyFans account that existed before the partnership. Because that means additional work, an extra 5% may be charged.
The main marketing investment stays focused on the account the agency builds.

questions.question: What is a residential proxy?
answer: It's a technology used to keep a stable, consistent residential connection while the account is managed.
Each model gets her own dedicated static residential proxy. This helps reduce the risks that come with an account being accessed from different countries, internet addresses and devices.

questions.question: What does the agency invest in me?
answer: We invest time, experience, technology, infrastructure and money in developing your brand.

That can include a dedicated residential proxy, a dedicated browser profile, professional marketing tools, analytics systems, content planning, day-to-day management, technical support, sales strategy and long-term development.
These resources are provided by the agency at no separate charge during the partnership, except where the contract specifies otherwise.

questions.question: Who talks to the subscribers?
answer: Our professional chatter team.
The work includes fast replies, building relationships, PPV sales, encouraging tips, subscriber retention and engaging conversation.
All of it respects the boundaries, preferences and rules you set.

questions.question: How many models does the agency manage?
answer: Our agency works with a maximum of 30 active models.
We would rather offer individual attention, constant communication and tailored strategies than manage hundreds of accounts without proper care.

questions.question: Can I leave the agency whenever I want?
answer: Yes. You can end the partnership at any time, following the procedure and conditions described in the contract.
If you decide to leave, we remove our access and handle the separation professionally and respectfully.
The main OnlyFans account created, structured and developed by the agency will be closed and will not be transferred to the model.
That is because the account represents an investment the agency made in branding, marketing, infrastructure, strategy, technology and business development.
If the model already had an account before the partnership and only contracted the additional management, that account remains hers and we remove our access when the partnership ends.

questions.question: Is there a long-term contract?
answer: We intend to build a lasting partnership, but it should continue because both sides are happy with the relationship and the results.
Cancellation procedures, financial responsibilities, account ownership and how operations wind down are all explained clearly in the contract.

questions.question: How do I join the agency?
answer: Click the Apply button and fill in the application form.
Once we receive your application we review your profile, get in touch, answer your questions and explain the process before any commitment.

invest.title: We Invest in You
invest.body: Unlike many agencies, we don't simply manage your account. We invest money, technology, infrastructure, experience and time to help you build a professional, secure and profitable business.

proxy.title: Dedicated Residential Proxy
paragraphs: We invest in a dedicated static residential proxy for every model. It provides a stable, consistent digital connection for managing the account.

That separation reduces operational mistakes, improves security and lets our team manage each brand inside its own infrastructure.

marketing.title: Professional Marketing Tools

These tools help us see what is working, test new strategies and steer our resources toward the actions that produce the best results.

analytics.title: Management and Analytics Tools

Your page is never on autopilot. Results are reviewed so we can adapt pricing, PPVs, content, campaigns and retention strategies.

family.title: We Treat Our Models Like Family

We believe the strongest businesses are built on trust, honesty, loyalty, communication and mutual respect.

recordingGuidelines.title: Recording Guidelines
recordingGuidelines.intro: Follow these guidelines to keep the quality of the content you send to Google Drive.

sections.title: Lighting
items: Always face the light — never shoot with the window or light source behind you.
Natural light or a ring light works best; avoid very dark rooms.

sections.title: Resolution and framing
items: Record at the highest resolution your phone offers (1080p minimum).
Keep the phone steady — use a tripod whenever you can.
Frame vertically for Stories/Reels, and horizontally when the team asks for it.

sections.title: Audio
items: Record somewhere quiet, with no fans, TV or background music.
Keep wind off the microphone when recording outdoors.

sections.title: Sending it in
items: Send content as soon as you can after recording, without editing it first.
Separate photos and videos by date where possible.
If you're unsure what to record, message the team on WhatsApp first.

googlePhotos.title: How to share your photos with Google Photos
googlePhotos.intro: Create an album with two vertical photos and two horizontal ones. Then copy the shareable link and paste it into the KARAY Models form.
checklist: Use sharp photos without heavy filters.
There's no need to send explicit content.
Check that anyone with the link can view the album.
googlePhotos.testLink: Test the link before sending it
googlePhotos.testLinkBody: Open the link in a private window, or send it to someone you trust. If the photos appear without asking for permission, the link is set up correctly.

iphoneSteps.title: Open Google Photos
iphoneSteps.text: Open the Google Photos app on your iPhone. If you don't have it yet, install it from the App Store and sign in with your Google account.

iphoneSteps.title: Select the four photos
iphoneSteps.text: Choose two recent vertical photos and two horizontal ones. There's no need to send explicit content.

iphoneSteps.title: Create an album
iphoneSteps.text: Tap “Add to” or the “+” symbol and choose “Album”. Name the album “KARAY Models Application”.

iphoneSteps.title: Check the album
iphoneSteps.text: Open the album and confirm all four photos appear correctly.

iphoneSteps.title: Share the album
iphoneSteps.text: Tap the share icon, then choose “Create link”, “Get link” or “Share link”.

iphoneSteps.title: Copy the link
iphoneSteps.text: Copy the link Google Photos created and go back to the KARAY Models form.

iphoneSteps.title: Paste the link into the form
iphoneSteps.text: Paste the link into the field on the application and check that it starts with photos.app.goo.gl or photos.google.com.

androidSteps.title: Open Google Photos
androidSteps.text: Open the Google Photos app on your Android phone and confirm you're signed in to your Google account.

androidSteps.title: Select the four photos
androidSteps.text: Choose two recent vertical photos and two horizontal ones — sharp, and without filters that significantly change how you look.

androidSteps.title: Create an album
androidSteps.text: Tap “Add to”, “+” or “New” and select “Album”. Name the album “KARAY Models Application”.

androidSteps.title: Check the album
androidSteps.text: Open the album and confirm all four photos are there.

androidSteps.title: Create the link
androidSteps.text: Tap “Share” and then “Create link”. On some phones this appears as “Get link”.

androidSteps.title: Copy the link
androidSteps.text: Tap “Copy link” and return to the application form.

androidSteps.title: Paste the link into the form
androidSteps.text: Paste the link into the Google Photos field and carry on with the rest of the application.
